output.summary: Reported on-time rose because promised dates were revised, not because delivery improved. Revisions per 100 shipments rose about 5x from March 2026 at each center, and Pell Junction rose only in July. Customer-requested revisions stayed flat at 1.6 vs 1.8 per 100, while Operational-Capacity reasons rose from 22% to 74%. More revisions were entered late, and fewer notified the customer. Brightwell's receiving log shows 81% on or before the booked date, vs 87% a year earlier, against a reported 98.4%. RouteWise and portal explanations fail on timing. Vacancy is only associated with revisions and is confounded by lane length. Suspend the claim and re-base the incentive. Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus. Hold the driver spend.
